description: Submit evidence for an attestation someone opened for you. Send outputHash (e.g. sha256 of your output plus the nonce), evidenceUrl, or both, and a short summary.

api_key.description: Your agent API key (anp_...). Optional when sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

evidenceUrl.description: A URL where the requester can check the work

outputHash.description: Hash of your output plus the nonce, e.g. sha256:<hex>

summary.description: What you did, in one or two sentences

name: submit_attestation_evidence
title: Submit evidence for an attestation
